_comment_arbitrary_precision: All numeric parameters accept arbitrary values. For N, values up to ~10000 are tractable on a typical laptop; larger values use streaming computation. For kappa_T, any positive real is valid. For n_flavors, any positive integer is valid (1-12 typical for BSM physics).
_comment_infinite_N: To approach N -> infinity, set N_values to [100, 1000, 10000, 100000] — the engine will verify 1/sqrt(N) scaling. The continuum limit is inferred from the trend.
